commit.message:
Fix CI: regenerate lockfile with missing esbuild platform packages

npm ci failed because @esbuild/*@0.27.7 platform-specific optional
dependencies were missing from package-lock.json.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
